name: pi-daemon
tagline: Persistent coding agent session with a mobile PWA client
description: pi-daemon is a persistent coding agent that runs in the background and can be driven from a mobile-friendly PWA. It keeps a long-lived session so context survives across interactions, and its mobile web client makes it easy to kick off or check on agent work from a phone. It targets the growing workflow of delegating long-running coding tasks to an agent you can monitor anywhere.
highlights: Persistent coding agent session that survives across interactions
Mobile-friendly PWA client for driving and monitoring agent work
curatorNote: The ability to drive a persistent coding agent from a phone is a practical step toward 'check on your agent from anywhere.' Early, but a useful pattern to watch.
